sources.title: NIST SP 800-63-4: Digital Identity Guidelines
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: WebAuthn 通行金鑰：來源、挑戰與驗證旗標
related.titleEn: WebAuthn passkeys: origins, challenges and verification flags
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：三個保證維度都有理由，所有失敗案例仍列在報告；通過率不被標為安全保證或標準認證。 交付三服務保證決策表、16項測試及兩項仍失敗的處理理由。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All three assurance dimensions are justified and all failures remain visible; pass rate is not labeled security assurance or certification. Deliver assurance decisions for three services, 16 tests and disposition of the two remaining failures.
related.difference: 在本機合成註冊與登入紀錄標示 challenge、origin、RP ID、user presence 與 user verification；列出伺服器需檢查的欄位及一次性消耗點。
related.differenceEn: Annotate challenge, origin, RP ID, user presence and user verification in synthetic registration and login records; list server-side checks and the one-time consumption point.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 保證向量是三個分開的要求；本地符合率只計算自訂的驗收案例，不可宣稱它就是 NIST 認證分數。 為自訂服務剖面列16個驗收案例；12個符合、4個失敗，所有案例權重相同僅供教學統計。 12/16×100=75%；修正其中兩個後14/16×100=87.5%，高風險失敗仍不可被平均掩蓋。
挑戰有效期與已使用旗標必須一起判定；驗證簽章只確認特定訊息與金鑰的關係，不能跳過來源或依賴方檢查。 自訂挑戰 TTL 為120秒，收到回應時年齡73秒；其餘必要欄位均符合且未曾使用。 有效餘裕120−73=47秒；TTL縮為90秒時餘裕90−73=17秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Assurance is a vector of separate requirements; local conformance counts only the chosen acceptance fixtures and is not a NIST certification score. A custom service profile has 16 acceptance fixtures: 12 pass and 4 fail, equally weighted only for teaching statistics. 12/16×100=75%; repairing two yields 14/16×100=87.5%, but averages cannot hide a high-impact failure.

Challenge age and consumed state must both be checked; signature verification binds message and key but does not replace origin or relying-party checks. A teaching challenge TTL is 120 seconds and response age is 73 seconds; other required fields match and the challenge is unused. Remaining margin is 120−73=47 seconds; reducing TTL to 90 gives 90−73=17 seconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OpenSSL mTLS：用途驗證與雙向身分
related.titleEn: OpenSSL mTLS: purpose checks and mutual identity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：三個保證維度都有理由，所有失敗案例仍列在報告；通過率不被標為安全保證或標準認證。 交付三服務保證決策表、16項測試及兩項仍失敗的處理理由。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All three assurance dimensions are justified and all failures remain visible; pass rate is not labeled security assurance or certification. Deliver assurance decisions for three services, 16 tests and disposition of the two remaining failures.
related.difference: 在離線測試資料夾設計三個客戶端、兩個服務、兩種EKU狀態；每列分開記錄伺服器驗客戶與客戶驗伺服器，無需對外開埠。
related.differenceEn: Design three clients, two services and two EKU states in an offline fixture folder; record server-to-client and client-to-server verification separately without external listeners.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 保證向量是三個分開的要求；本地符合率只計算自訂的驗收案例，不可宣稱它就是 NIST 認證分數。 為自訂服務剖面列16個驗收案例；12個符合、4個失敗，所有案例權重相同僅供教學統計。 12/16×100=75%；修正其中兩個後14/16×100=87.5%，高風險失敗仍不可被平均掩蓋。
mTLS建立兩個方向的認證，授權仍需獨立決定；完整測試矩陣數為客戶端×服務×用途狀態。 基準3客戶端、2服務、2種EKU狀態；每一組指定允許或拒絕及原因。 3×2×2=12組；加入第4個客戶端後4×2×2=16組。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Assurance is a vector of separate requirements; local conformance counts only the chosen acceptance fixtures and is not a NIST certification score. A custom service profile has 16 acceptance fixtures: 12 pass and 4 fail, equally weighted only for teaching statistics. 12/16×100=75%; repairing two yields 14/16×100=87.5%, but averages cannot hide a high-impact failure.

mTLS authenticates in both directions but authorization remains separate; complete tests equal clients×services×purpose states. Baseline uses 3 clients, 2 services and 2 EKU states; each combination has an expected decision and reason. 3×2×2=12 combinations; adding a fourth client gives 4×2×2=16.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

courses.overview: 比較相鄰案例與另一組案例的模型、可量測結果及可轉移的驗證方法。
